ei.title: The Danger of a Comfortable Rut
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Success can lead you off your intended path and into a comfortable rut. If you are good at something and are well rewarded for doing it, you may want to keep doing it even if you stop enjoying it. The danger is that one day you look around and realize you're so deep in this comfortable rut that you can no longer see the sun or breathe fresh air; the sides of the rut have become so slippery that it would take a superhuman effort to climb out; and, effectively, you're stuck. And it's a situation that many working people worry they're in now. The poor employment market has left them feeling locked in what may be a secure, or even well-paying—but ultimately unsatisfying — job.

✅ ③ enjoying: 'stop enjoying it'에서 stop + V-ing — 적절
✅ ④ slippery: 형용사 수식 — 적절
det.tip: be well rewarded = 잘 보상받다. 수동태 = be + p.p.

questions.passage: Success can lead you off your intended path and into a comfortable rut. If you are good at something and are well rewarded for doing it, you may want to keep doing it even if you stop enjoying it. The danger is that one day you look around and realize you're so deep in this comfortable rut that you can no longer see the sun or breathe fresh air; the sides of the rut have become so slippery that it would take a superhuman effort to climb out; and, effectively, you're stuck. And it's a situation that many working people worry they're in now. The poor employment market has left them feeling locked in what may be a secure, or even well-paying—but ultimately unsatisfying — job.
